svg.title: Brokered UCaaS Price Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-brokered-ucaas-price-ladder; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Brokered UCaaS Price Ladder; subtitle: Monthly per-seat prices from full contact center down to brokered Zoom Phone; caption: Contact center quotes span $69 to $149 per agent, while add-ons and brokered phone seats compress the monthly bill well below list.; assumptions note: Values are monthly prices as quoted by practitioners; contact center is per agent, the Customer Engagement Pack is per supervisor and Zoom Phone is per user. The broker fee is paid by the provider, not the customer.; note: Attributed to Mike Smith of AeroCom Inc, with the contact center range as quoted by UCaaS channel practitioners.; stages: label: Full Contact Center Ceiling; value: 149; display: $149 per agent per month; conversion: Top of the $69 to $149 quoted range; detail: Analysts still call Zoom Contact Center a 1.0 product.; label: Full Contact Center Floor; value: 69; display: $69 per agent per month; conversion: Bottom of the $69 to $149 quoted range; detail: Features are sliding into the base UCaaS license.; label: Customer Engagement Pack Add-On; value: 20; display: $20 per supervisor per month; conversion: Positioned against $100+ per agent full licensing; detail: Real-time queue analytics sold as a $20-$25 upsell.; label: Zoom Phone Unlimited List; value: 15; display: $15 per user per month; conversion: List anchor before brokering; detail: Most popular Zoom Phone tier.; label: Zoom Phone Unlimited Brokered; value: 10; display: Below $10 per user per month; conversion: Sometimes $8-$9 against the $15 list; detail: Never let a 100-plus-user buyer go direct; the provider pays the broker fee.

circle.title: label: Full Contact Center Ceiling; value: 149; display: $149 per agent per month; conversion: Top of the $69 to $149 quoted range; detail: Analysts still call Zoom Contact Center a 1.0 product.
label: Full Contact Center Floor; value: 69; display: $69 per agent per month; conversion: Bottom of the $69 to $149 quoted range; detail: Features are sliding into the base UCaaS license.

label: Customer Engagement Pack Add-On; value: 20; display: $20 per supervisor per month; conversion: Positioned against $100+ per agent full licensing; detail: Real-time queue analytics sold as a $20-$25 upsell.
label: Zoom Phone Unlimited List; value: 15; display: $15 per user per month; conversion: List anchor before brokering; detail: Most popular Zoom Phone tier.

label: Zoom Phone Unlimited Brokered; value: 10; display: Below $10 per user per month; conversion: Sometimes $8-$9 against the $15 list; detail: Never let a 100-plus-user buyer go direct; the provider pays the broker fee.

text.title: Assumptions: Values are monthly prices as quoted by practitioners; contact center is per agent, the Customer Engagement Pack is per supervisor and Zoom Phone is per user. The broker fee is paid by the provider, not the customer.

supervisor and Zoom Phone is per user. The broker fee is paid by the provider, not the customer.
